description: This file defines controller functions for generating commit reports based on diff targets in a repository management application. It includes logic for fetching commit data, generating CSV reports, and handling related repository interactions.

methods.name: GenerateCommitReport
methods.description: Main function that iterates over diff targets in the application configuration and generates individual commit reports for each.

methods.name: generateCommitReport
methods.description: Generates a commit report CSV for a specific diff target by fetching commits and writing to a file.

methods.name: filenameForTarget
methods.description: Constructs the filename for the CSV report based on the current timestamp and diff target branches.
